methodology.cpu_denominator: Main-thread jdk.ExecutionSample counts (not wall-clock or absolute CPU milliseconds). First-app and phases/work categories are disjoint; inclusive method counts overlap and cannot be summed.
methodology.native_denominator: Main-thread jdk.NativeMethodSample counts, separate from Java execution; may include waiting.
methodology.compiler_duration: Sum of jdk.Compilation durations across concurrent compiler threads, not elapsed time or exact CPU time.
phase_priority: PropertiesImpl.resolveBy => resolution, including nested property lookup
methodology.classloading: orthogonal main Java stack occurrence of ClassLoader load/find/defineClass, internal loader equivalents, Class.forName, or Unsafe.ensureClassInitialized
